svg.text: SEPARATION OF CONCERNS: NORMATIVE SPECIFICATION VS. REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATIONS
Relationship between vendor-neutral functional requirements (ISO/IEC Directives, Part 2) and open-source software implementations
SPECIFICATION TRACK · FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Standardisation Scope: CEN/CLC JTC 25 (WG 2 Dataspaces & WG 3 Data Governance)
1. Technology-Agnostic Functional Requirements (Clauses 5–9)
• Specifies functional criteria for runtime constraint evaluation and audit records
• Supports EAS 18425:2026 (CL3–CL4), FprEN 18352, and EN 18235-2:2026
• Deliverable Type: European Agile Specification (EAS) / Technical Specification (TS)
2. Standardized Work Products (Clauses 6, 8 & Annexes A, D)
• Work Product 1: Provenance-Attested Constraint Schema (semantic_hash)
• Work Product 2: Semantic Certificate (S-Cert) Audit Payload Schema
payload_hash + semantic_hash + process_urn + correlation_id
3. Clean Legal & IP Boundary
• Paper specification only; zero dependency on any GitHub repository
• Normative references cite ISO/CEN standards & persistent Zenodo DOIs
• Implementable by any vendor in Java, Rust, Python, Go, or SQL
IMPLEMENTATION TRACK · INFORMATIVE REFERENCE SOFTWARE
Open-Source Ecosystem Alignment: Eclipse Dataspace Working Group (Apache 2.0)
1. Vendor-Neutral Reference Software (Apache 2.0)
• Headless runtime policy enforcement point (PEP) and S-Cert generator
• Demonstrates implementability without mandating any single vendor or stack
• Informative status only; conformance is strictly to the written specification
2. Interoperability with Dataspace Control-Plane Components
• Eclipse CAP (v2.2.1): Exports S-Cert as W3C VC v2.0 cred:Evidence
• Eclipse DRP & W3C ODRL 2.2: Enforces bound usage obligations at runtime
• Gaia-X DTA & EDC: Discharges post-transfer obligations (EN 18235-2 §5.8)
3. Conformance Testing & Verification (Clause 9)
• Open test suite for Level 1 (Core) and Level 2 (Attested) conformance
• Compatible with ISO/IEC 10118-3 hashing & ISO/IEC 14888-3 signatures
• Enables independent third-party audit without exposing raw data payloads
DECOUPLED
Spec ≠ Code
